verdict.rationale: Kong's plugin architecture lets operators attach actions (rate limiting, transformations, logging, security policies) that fire automatically on gateway events like incoming requests, auth failures, or AI traffic patterns (kong-gh-3, kong-docs-60, kong-docs-64), which is a form of automatic rule-triggered action. However, this is scoped to API/AI traffic lifecycle events rather than a general-purpose event/rule automation engine, and there's no explicit doc of user-defined custom triggers/conditions beyond built-in plugin hooks. Missing for 10: a dedicated rules/automation engine spec, examples of custom event-condition-action definitions, and independent validation of this automation depth.
